title: RecoRunSample
description: One line of a '*.samples.jsonl' file: the result of one sample in a run (reco-run.schema.json). Paths are relative to the folder of the run record. With 'fields', two runs can be compared per sample and field (improved, regressed, changed and still wrong, unchanged); the tool computes the comparison, it is not stored. Issue: cassandragargoyle/api #56.

sample.description: Sample path; identifies the sample when two runs are compared

prediction.description: Output file of the engine for the sample

prediction_value.description: Short output of the engine (e.g. a class label) instead of an output file

prediction_format.description: Format of the output; known values: 'reco-export-xml', 'ocr-result', 'label'

error.description: Why the engine gave no result for the sample

MetricValues.description: Metric values by metric name of the lab document

FieldResult.description: Result of one field (for example one zone of a form template)

field.description: Field name (e.g. the 'export_name' of a template zone); identifies the field when two runs are compared

zone_id.description: Zone of the field, so a viewer can show it on the sample

component.description: Engine component that recognized the field

expected.description: Value from the ground truth; '' for an empty field

predicted.description: Value from the engine; null when the engine gave no value

flagged.description: The engine marked the value as suspicious
